```{r setup-id, include=FALSE}
# testset (id of current run) should be a parameter passed to the qmd report
# lets assume hiroTGH is the current run
run_id = "hiroTGH"
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyplots)  # For enhanced plots
library(ggridges)   # For ridge plots
library(patchwork)  # For combining plots
library(DT)         # For interactive tables
library(viridis)    # For better color palettes
library(readr)      # For reading data
library(here)       # For file paths
library(showtext)   # For FontAwesome support


# Set up FontAwesome
font_add('FontAwesome', 'assets/fonts/fontawesome-webfont.ttf')
showtext_auto()

# Helper function to create nicer labels
nice_label <- function(x) {
  x %>% 
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    str_to_title()
}

report_dir = "report"
```

```{r load-data}
# Set paths - these should be parameters that can be passed to the script
# lets assume the files have been copied to current directory
# use here() to get the current directory
results_dir <- here(report_dir)
# get all files in the results_dir that match the pattern
score_files <- list.files(results_dir, pattern = "pgs.txt", full.names = FALSE)
popsim_files <- list.files(results_dir, pattern = "popsimilarity.txt", full.names = FALSE)

# Load score data
scores <- read_tsv(here(report_dir, score_files))

# Load popsim data
  popsim <- read_tsv(here(report_dir, popsim_files))

# Get basic stats
n_scores <- length(unique(scores$PGS))
n_samples <- length(unique(scores$IID))

scores_popsim <- scores %>%
  left_join(popsim %>% select(IID, MostSimilarPop), by = "IID")

# Create comprehensive run_patient_data with all necessary variables
run_patient_data <- scores_popsim %>%
  # Filter to non-reference samples
  filter(sampleset != "reference") %>%
  # Join with population data
  # Calculate overall percentiles
  mutate(Overall_Percentile = round(percent_rank(Z_MostSimilarPop) * 100, 1)) %>%
  # Calculate population-specific percentiles
  group_by(MostSimilarPop) %>%
  mutate(Population_Percentile = round(percent_rank(Z_MostSimilarPop) * 100, 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Limit to first 64 patients
  head(64)

# Get reference data
reference_data <- scores_popsim %>% filter(sampleset == "reference")

# Select one random patient for individual analysis
if(n_samples > 0) {
  patient_id <- sample(unique(run_patient_data$IID), 1)
  patient_data <- run_patient_data %>% filter(IID == patient_id)
  
  # Combine patient and reference data for individual analysis
  analysis_data <- bind_rows(patient_data, reference_data)

cat("## Summary Statistics\n\n")
cat("- **Number of scores calculated:** ", n_scores, "\n")
cat("- **Number of samples analyzed:** ", n_samples, "\n")

# Print patient summary
cat("## Patient Summary\n\n")
cat("**Patient ID:** ", patient_id, "\n\n")
cat("**Overall Percentile:** ", analysis_data %>% filter(IID == patient_id) %>% pull(Overall_Percentile), "%\n\n")
}

# Check if we have low sample size
low_sample_size <- n_samples < 50
if(low_sample_size) {
  cat("\n::: {.callout-warning}\n")
  cat("### Small Sample Size Warning\n")
  cat("- Sample size is less than 50\n")
  cat("- Small sample sizes may affect the reliability of PGS calculations\n")
  cat("- Consider results with caution\n")
  cat(":::\n")
}
```


# patient percentile plot

```{r}
#| label: patient-risk-viz
#| 
# Function to create patient risk visualization with human icons
create_patient_risk_viz <- function(patient_id, by_ancestry = FALSE) {
  # Get patient data
  if(nrow(scores %>% filter(IID == patient_id)) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "Patient not found") + 
           theme_void())
  }

  if(by_ancestry) {
    patient_percentile <- run_patient_data %>%
      filter(IID == patient_id) %>%
      pull(Population_Percentile)
  } else {
    patient_percentile <- run_patient_data %>%
      filter(IID == patient_id) %>%
      pull(Overall_Percentile)
  }
  
  # Create grid positions (10 rows x 10 columns)
  n_rows <- 10
  n_cols <- 10
  grid_positions <- expand.grid(
    row = 1:n_rows,  # Normal row order (1-10)
    col = 1:n_cols
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      percentile_range = case_when(
        row == 1 ~ "0-10",
        row == 10 ~ "91-100",
        TRUE ~ paste0(((row - 1) * 10 + 1), "-", (row * 10))
      ),
      # Fix percentile range calculation
      row_start = (row - 1) * 10,  # Lower bound of the range
      row_end = row * 10,          # Upper bound of the range
      is_patient_row = patient_percentile > row_start & patient_percentile <= row_end
    )
  
  # Create the plot
  ggplot(grid_positions, aes(x = col, y = row, color = is_patient_row)) +
    # Add arrow for risk direction
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = n_cols + 1.2,
      xend = n_cols + 1.2,
      y = 1,
      yend = n_rows,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "last"),  # Arrow only points up
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      label = "\uf007",  # FontAwesome user icon
      family = "FontAwesome",
      size = 7,         # Reduced size
      vjust = 0.5,    # Center vertically
      hjust = 0.5,    # Center horizontally
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "gray80", "TRUE" = "#3366CC")) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = 1:n_rows,
      labels = c("0-10", "11-20", "21-30", "31-40", "41-50", 
                "51-60", "61-70", "71-80", "81-90", "91-100"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.1))  # More expansion at top
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.15)),  # More expansion at right
      limits = c(0.5, n_cols + 1.5)   # Adjusted limits
    ) +
    labs(
      title = if(by_ancestry) "Within Ancestry Group" else "Overall Population",
      subtitle = paste0(round(patient_percentile, 1), "th percentile"),
      y = "Percentile Range",
      x = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 40, b = 20, l = 20)  # Adjusted margins
    ) +
    # Add risk labels
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = n_cols + 1.5,  # Moved slightly right
      y = n_rows,
      label = "higher\nrisk",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 3.75
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = n_cols + 1.5,  # Moved slightly right
      y = 1,
      label = "lower\nrisk",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 3.75
    ) 
}
```

```{r patient-risk-viz-calls}
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 8
#| warning: false

# Create plot directory if it doesn't exist
plot_dir <- here(report_dir, "plots")
if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
  dir.create(plot_dir)
}

# Get list of all patient IDs (up to 64)
all_patient_ids <- unique(run_patient_data$IID)

# get 5 for testing
all_patient_ids <- all_patient_ids[1:5]

# Save plots for all patients
for (pid in all_patient_ids) {
  # Create both plots
  p1 <- create_patient_risk_viz(pid, by_ancestry = TRUE)
  p2 <- create_patient_risk_viz(pid, by_ancestry = FALSE)
  
  # Combine plots with patchwork
  combined_plot <- p1 + p2 +
    plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1)) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste("Risk Percentile for Patient", pid),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
    )
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(
    filename = here(plot_dir, paste0("patient_", pid, "_risk_plot.png")),
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = 6,
    height = 3,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

# Test with a random sample and create side-by-side plots for display in this report
if(n_samples > 0) {
  # Create both plots for the random patient
  p1 <- create_patient_risk_viz(patient_id, by_ancestry = TRUE)
  p2 <- create_patient_risk_viz(patient_id, by_ancestry = FALSE)
  
  # Combine plots with patchwork
  combined_plot <- p1 + p2 +
    plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1)) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste("Risk Percentile for Patient", patient_id),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
    )
  
  print(combined_plot)
}

```

## summary text file with interactive html table

```{r patient-summary-text}
# Save all patient summaries to file
output_file <- "patient_summaries.csv"
text_data <- run_patient_data %>%
  # Format the summary line
  mutate(
    Summary = sprintf(
      "Patient: %s, Score: %s, Overall Percentile: %.1f%%, Ancestry: %s, Ancestry Percentile: %.1f%%",
      IID,
      Z_MostSimilarPop,
      Overall_Percentile,
      MostSimilarPop,
      Population_Percentile
    )
  )

# Save all data to file
writeLines(text_data$Summary, here(report_dir, output_file))
message(paste("Patient summaries saved to:", normalizePath(here(report_dir, output_file))))

# Display subset in report
# Show first 64 patients in an interactive table
run_patient_data %>%
  head(64) %>%
  select(IID, Z_MostSimilarPop, Overall_Percentile, MostSimilarPop, Population_Percentile) %>%
  rename(
    "Patient ID" = IID,
    "Score" = Z_MostSimilarPop,
    "Overall Percentile" = Overall_Percentile,
    "Ancestry" = MostSimilarPop,
    "Ancestry Percentile" = Population_Percentile
  ) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    options = list(
      dom = 'Bfrtip',
      buttons = c('csv', 'excel'),
      pageLength = 10
    ),
    caption = "Patient Summary (First 64 Patients)"
  ) %>%
  DT::formatRound(columns = c("Score", "Overall Percentile", "Ancestry Percentile"), digits = 2)
```

## Score Distributions (boxplot + jittered points for run_patient_data)
```{r}
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 8
#| warning: false
# Create enhanced density plots with standard ggplot2
ggplot(run_patient_data, aes(x = PGS, y = Z_MostSimilarPop)) +
  # Add boxplot
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
  # Add jittered points
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.3,
    size = 2
  ) +
  # Highlight patient point
  geom_point(
    data = analysis_data %>% filter(IID == patient_id),
    size = 4,
    shape = 17,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  # Add mean line
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.5,
    color = "darkblue"
  ) +
  # Apply a consistent theme
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PGS Score Distribution",
    subtitle = paste("Patient", patient_id, "highlighted in red"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "PGS Score (Z_MostSimilarPop)"
  )
```

### Ridge Plots for Score Comparison (using predicted ancestries)

```{r ridge-plots}
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 8
#| warning: false

# Only use reference data for ridge plot, but add patient data point. have several ridgeplots for each most similar population
scores_popsim %>%
  mutate(PGS = fct_reorder(MostSimilarPop, Z_MostSimilarPop, .fun=median)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop, y = MostSimilarPop, fill = MostSimilarPop)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.7,
    quantile_lines = TRUE,
    quantiles = 2,
    scale = 0.9
  ) +
  # Add individual patient data points
  geom_point(
    data = scores_popsim %>% filter(IID == patient_id),
    aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop, y = MostSimilarPop),
    size = 3,
    shape = 17,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of PGS Scores by PGS ID",
    subtitle = paste("Patient", patient_id, "highlighted in red"),
    x = "PGS Score",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_ridges() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

### Histogram + density line

```{r histogram-density-plot}
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 8
#| warning: false
# histogram + density lines, signal patient data point. 
# Create histogram with density overlay
ggplot(scores_popsim, aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  # Use stat_density instead of geom_density to ensure the density line shows
  stat_density(
    geom = "area",
    color = "firebrick",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  # Add vertical line for patient
  geom_vline(
    data = scores_popsim %>% filter(IID == patient_id),
    aes(xintercept = Z_MostSimilarPop),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Add text annotation for patient
  geom_text(
    data = scores_popsim %>% filter(IID == patient_id),
    aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop, y = max(density(scores_popsim$Z_MostSimilarPop)$y) * 0.8, 
        label = paste("Patient", patient_id)),
    color = "red",
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of PGS Scores",
    subtitle = "Patient highlighted in red",
    x = "Z-Score (Most Similar Population)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

### density lines for each ancestry group

```{r density-lines}
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 8
#| warning: false

# Create a plot with one density line per ancestry group, overlayed on top of each other
# The overall density line should be the only one with a fill color
ggplot() +
  # Add the overall density with fill
  geom_density(
    data = scores_popsim,
    aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop),
    fill = "gray80",
    alpha = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Add individual ancestry group densities without fill
  geom_density(
    data = scores_popsim,
    aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop, color = MostSimilarPop),
    alpha = 0.8,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Add vertical line for patient
  geom_vline(
    data = scores_popsim %>% filter(IID == patient_id),
    aes(xintercept = Z_MostSimilarPop),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Add text annotation for patient
  geom_text(
    data = scores_popsim %>% filter(IID == patient_id),
    aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop, y = max(density(scores_popsim$Z_MostSimilarPop)$y) * 0.9, 
        label = paste("Patient", patient_id)),
    color = "red",
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of PGS Scores by Ancestry Group",
    x = "Z-Score (Most Similar Population)",
    y = "Density",
    color = "Ancestry Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d()
```
